summary.headline: Astrological Judgments, Folios 55v–59v
summary.text: Astrological recipe list from a Florentine codex, covering oriental and occidental Mars, determining human nature, death timing and causes, benefits, bodily features, prostitution, malefic effects, lunar configurations, planetary powers, bicorporeal signs, and fortune, with manuscript folio references 55v–59v.
